I have built and verified the counter web page in `/workspace`:

- [counter.mjs](file:///workspace/counter.mjs) — Exports the pure [`increment`](file:///workspace/counter.mjs#L1-L3) function.
- [app.mjs](file:///workspace/app.mjs) — Wires `#increment-btn` clicks to update `#count` using [`increment`](file:///workspace/counter.mjs#L1-L3).
- [index.html](file:///workspace/index.html) — Minimal counter page displaying `0` and an `Increment` button, loading [app.mjs](file:///workspace/app.mjs) as an ES module.
- [counter.test.mjs](file:///workspace/counter.test.mjs) — Node built-in test suite (`node:test` and `node:assert/strict`).
